title: Head-state body labels
statement: For a natural number $k$ and a finite binary Turing machine $M$, define a map from head states to program labels as follows: a state $cA(\tau,t_0)$ maps to the template label for cell $(\tau,t_0)$ at phase $1$, and $cB(\tau,t_0)$ maps to the corresponding phase-$3$ label. A state $iz(t_0)$ maps to $zb(t_0)$, a state $iu(t_0)$ maps to $ub(t_0)$, and the layout state maps to the label $lay(false)$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite binary Turing machine
